notes.title: ver1.04 Patch
notes.content:
We have fixed the following in this update:
------------------------------------------------------
- Added missing CG in "Escalating Tension"
- Replaced text appearing in "0/10 Do Not Recommend" and "The Runway" to better fit these scenes.
------------------------------------------------------
The game should update automatically if you have auto-update enabled.
(It's on by default)

notes.title: ver1.02 Patch
notes.content:
We have fixed the following in this update:
------------------------------------------------------
1. Corrected a sequence of CGs that wasn't displaying correctly.
2. Fixed a bug where a post-ending extra didn't unlock under certain circumstances.
3. Fixes typos and text overflows.
------------------------------------------------------
The game should update automatically if you have auto-update enabled.
(It's on by default)
